messages:
sam: Quick postmortem follow-up - streaming chat partials/timeouts last night. Can we lock owners and immediate mitigations?
maya: I can take short-term mitigation for client-side retries/backoff and update docs with the expected retry window.
kevin: Thanks Maya. Can you confirm retry window and whether we should bump client max attempts from 3 -> 5?
maya: Proposed: exponential backoff starting 200ms, cap backoff at 3s, max attempts 4. Keeps users from hammering while giving good chance to recover.
priya: From infra I'll bump the LB handshake timeout to 10s on canary and watch for reduction in partials.
lia: I'll own SDK reconnect investigation - specifically looking for cases that double-send KV cache on reconnect. ETA EOD tomorrow.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-171900 - Chat streaming partials. Priority: P2.
sam: Can we list action items with owners and deadlines so oncall has clarity?
maya: A1 (owner: maya) - SDK guidance + example changes (exponential backoff + cap). Due: 1719080000.
priya: A2 (owner: priya) - LB timeout bump to canary + grafana panel for handshake latency and streaming 4xxs. Due: 1719020000.
kevin: A3 (owner: kevin) - Server-side reconnect telemetry: emit "reconnect_reason", "handshake_ms", "kv_cache_hits", "final_status_code" to help triage partials. Due: 1719120000.
lia: A4 (owner: lia) - SDK reconnect test harness + regression tests including idempotency token validations. Due: 1719180000.
sam: Oncall playbook item: if partial rate >3% over baseline for 10m -> rollback to previous model-variant and page infra. Lia, can you draft a one-pager?
lia: Will draft and drop a gist here.
maya: Quick mitigation PR for SDK ready - adding backoff + max attempts. Kevin, can you review?
kevin: Skimming. One Q: how do we avoid duplicate messages after reconnect when KV cache is partial?
maya: We'll add idempotency tokens in next PR. Short-term we rely on best-effort dedupe and retries limited to 4 attempts.
priya: Creating alert STREAM_PARTIAL_RATE. Threshold: 3% over 10m. Will link runbook.
sam: Let's sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to review telemetry and decide on full postmortem.
oncall-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled for 1719087000 (2026-03-26 10:30 PT).
kevin: If a rollback is needed, use infra rollback playbook: https://internal.redwood/infra/rollback (read-only).
maya: Noted region note - partials clustered in eu-west. Priya please check node logs for that region.
priya: Pulling logs now; will post any patterns.
sam: I'll update central action tracker and tag owners. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
